findings.title: All visible registration CTAs are non-interactive spans
findings.location: Hero and all four ticket cards
findings.fix: Give each CTA a real destination and render it as a native link or button.

findings.title: The Chinese-majority page declares lang=en-US
findings.fix: Use zh-Hant as the page language and mark English passages with lang=en.

findings.wcag: WCAG 2.2: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
findings.title: The page has no H1 and section/item headings share the same H2 level
findings.fix: Use one H1 for the event, H2 for sections, H3 for speakers and schedule items, then H4 only for subordinate ticket details.

findings.title: Three speaker disclosures have the identical name READ ENGLISH BIO
findings.fix: Include the speaker name in each disclosure label.

findings.title: The Makoto Ueki link is a # placeholder and all three social links have empty href values
findings.location: Makoto Ueki card and footer social links
findings.fix: Add the intended destinations or remove the links until destinations exist.

findings.title: Schedule and ticket text columns collapse below readable width
findings.location: 320px schedule text about 128px; 768px ticket list text about 39px
findings.fix: Stack the schedule columns on narrow screens and change ticket cards to minmax(20rem, 1fr) with fewer columns as space shrinks.

findings.title: Seven page assets are authored with HTTP URLs and rely on browser upgrade
findings.location: Hero, speaker images, icons and Values background
findings.fix: Replace the stored asset URLs with HTTPS URLs.
